profile_text.body:
Shopify Inc. is a public company headquartered in Ottawa, listed under the ticker SHOP with CIK 0001594805. Its own site describes it as an all-in-one commerce platform for businesses, offering more than ecommerce software, with tools to manage every part of a business. The company invites businesses to try Shopify free and says they can build or grow quickly with AI.

On the AI side, the site says merchants can get discovered across AI channels, with shoppers checking out right in the chat and the merchant not lifting a finger. It attributes this to Agentic Storefronts. The site presents AI as part of both building a business and being found by buyers, rather than as a separate product line.
